cases.expected: true if mockedDelegateMap equals the object, false otherwise
cases.description: Test equals when delegateMap is not null, should delegate comparison to delegateMap.
Test equals with a non-Map object, should return false.
Test equals with another empty map, should return true.
Test equals with another map of different size, should return false.
Test equals with another map of the same size but different keys, should return false.
Test equals with another map having same size and keys but different values, should return false.
Test equals with another map having same size, keys, and values, should return true.
Test equals with another map having same size and keys but only some values matching, should return false.
Test equals with another map having the same size and keys but all values different, should return false.
Test equals with another map having the same keys but only one value different, should return false.
Test equals with another map having same size, keys, and one value as null, should return true if the corresponding value in Flat3Map is also null.
Test equals with another map having same size and keys but some values null and others different, should return false.
Test equals with another map having same size and keys but in different order, should return true as order does not matter for map equality.
Test equals with another map having same keys and values but with different types, should return false.
Test equals with another map containing a null key, should return false if Flat3Map does not have a corresponding null key.
Test equals with another map containing a null value, should return false if Flat3Map has a non-null value for the same key.
Test equals with another map having same keys and values but with different types, should return false.
